# Free copies listed by Europe PMC: browser retrieval (2026-11-14)

*Generated by `analysis/corpus/free_copies/summarize.py` from a headless-Chromium run (`fetch_browser.js`, Playwright defaults, no user-agent spoofing). Saved files are in the git-ignored `data/literature/free_copies/<disease>/`; per-paper outcomes in `analysis/corpus/free_copies/status_2026-11-14.csv`.*

Input: the papers in `reports/paywalled_papers_<date>.csv` whose Europe PMC listing (2026-10-20) is OA or F. Challenge pages (Cloudflare, reCAPTCHA, Anubis) were recorded and not interacted with. These files are **not** in the frozen corpus; adding them is a decision for Jimmy.
